name: Abendego's Squall (5-6)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.
disable: DC 23 Medicine check (expert) to remove the harpoon, DC 25 Nature check (trained) to calm the orca, or DC 27 Intimidation check (expert) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
routine:
Abendego's Squall thrashes against the hull of the Snapdragon. With each action, it makes a flipper Strike against a PC adjacent to the railing. Whenever it makes a flipper Strike, it also deals its Strike damage to the ship whether or not the Strike was successful.

Speed 30 feet

offensiveAbilities.name: Thar She Blows
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Abendego's Squall matches speed with the Snapdragon

Effect The orca leaps across the Snapdragon and tears its main mast from the deck in the process. This deals 30 damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on deck take 4d8+4 bludgeoning damage from the shrapnel and must attempt a DC 25 basic Reflex save. Abendego's Squall rolls initiative.
